objective: Maximize practical probability of Y2 Aug Public/Koshien title on iOS Ver1.42, using lower-confidence detailed guides as operational candidates while preserving evidence labels.

rules.rule: Start region candidate is Hokkaido for practical success; this is not a proof of global fastest region.
Protagonist baseline is pitcher / がんばり屋 / initial 30pt all velocity. This is an old detailed-guide candidate, not a Ver1.42 optimum. Record Creation Preview and Registered Initial separately.
Cheer-OFF special training is prohibited by default. Accumulate Cheer to >=20 through normal progression/activities and use Cheer-ON on long-horizon core.

Low-level-first principle: use justified ability items and special training on Y2-Aug core before mass match leveling. Current Wiki mechanic says level strongly affects training/item gains; Ver1.42 confirmation is still required.
Batter development default is slugging/long-ball main and batting secondary. Initial training pair is long-ball then batting; thereafter failure-mode rules override the default.
Do not spend scarce training merely to activate an affinity trio. Growth/remaining tenure/current role outrank affinity unless measured ROI says otherwise.
Match density stays high, but opponent difficulty is capped by win reliability. New opponent tests are interleaved with farm blocks; do not chain clear losses upward.
Operational match target: 3-4/month before recovery depth, 4-5/month after recovery depth, only when HP/calendar allow. This is a practical target synthesized from sources, not a fixed optimum.
For otherwise-equal farm choices prefer a full 6-inning win over a mercy result because current Wiki reports post-match points equal outs recorded; live verification remains desirable.
Opponent advance gate: after a loss/draw to a new opponent, farm a beaten lower/equal-grade opponent before retry. Two equivalent failed retries trigger method change.

Pitcher investment is velocity-first by default because multiple guides prioritize velocity; control/shadow overrides when walks/control failure repeat. Breaking becomes secondary once velocity is no longer the binding failure.
Baseball field removal is default GO once replacement construction is usable. Do not literally copy old-guide bath counts; recovery buildings scale only to observed HP bottlenecks.
Y1 Sep county title is a practical hard milestone. Y1 Oct regional loss is acceptable for E2 and may unlock recovery facilities; do not intentionally lose.
Reserve Study30 by principal-introduction timing unless live Ver1.42 presents a higher-value conflicting use.
Practical branch permits selective reload on route-critical official close losses only. Never use repeated reloads to bridge a structural power gap.
Live Ver1.42 overrides all public/old-guide claims on mechanics, timing, unlocks, costs, and numeric effects.

failure_mode_rules.offense_contact: If repeated <=3 hits or heavy strikeout pattern against farm-grade teams, prioritize batting/contact training even if long-ball is default.
failure_mode_rules.offense_conversion: If 4-7 hits but repeated 0-1 run output, prioritize slugging/skills.
failure_mode_rules.pitch_control: If >=3 BB/HBP-equivalent control failures recur in two comparable games, prioritize control/shadow.
failure_mode_rules.pitch_power: If walks are controlled but repeated hard-contact/run allowance persists, prioritize velocity.
failure_mode_rules.recovery: If a valuable match/training action is blocked by HP twice in a short window, add recovery capacity or use recovery items.

hard_gates.Y2_Apr: summer county entry confirmed + C stable / B challengeable

explicit_unknowns: exact match-yield scaling by opponent grade
